verdict.rationale: Any public web property, including a state filing office, could publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so this axis applies. The evidence shows no llms.txt or agent-facing documentation. Instead, both www.nvsos.gov and the ESOS/ORION filing portal put a bot wall (Akamai 403 or Incapsula interstitial) in front of keyless agents, even at robots.txt.
